_meta.contents: banked values by named key + fixed constants, grid generators and tokens + a derived reference section; no anchor value; no observational number; no point count
_meta.dqf_basis_note: index order of the chat quadform-basis diagnostic; asserted by this builder: k7[0..2] equal the fit7 kappa22, kappa24, kappa44 of the same key bit for bit and k7[3..6] equal the CC named cubic terms to 1e-4 relative; k12[3..6] equal k7[3..6] to 1e-8 relative (the shared order); the k12 quartic indices 7..11 follow the monomial order and are not independently confirmed (no instrument reads them)

synthetic_rules.margin_negative: [w + f1*(h - w), w + f2*(h - w)], w = unions.widened_all[0], h = unions.hull_all[0]
synthetic_rules.margin_positive: [h + f1*(w - h), h + f2*(w - h)], h = unions.hull_all[1], w = unions.widened_all[1]
synthetic_rules.robustness_only_positive: [p + f1*(q - p), p + f2*(q - p)], p = unions.widened_primary[1], q = unions.hull_all[1]

grids.fit_window: abs(t) <= D, inclusive (the window both banked legs used; H-CC-1)
grids.grid5x5_layout: row-major, t2 outer, t4 inner: index = 5*i + j for (t2_axis[i], t4_axis[j])
